title: deparia zeylanica
intro: Deparia zeylanica, commonly known as Ceylon spleenwort or Himalayan spleenwort, is a species of fern native to Sri Lanka and parts of the Himalayas. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and reduce blood pressure due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Deparia zeylanica include its potential to act as an anti-cancer agent and its ability to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria and viruses. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
